attackProtection.title: Attack Protection
attackProtection.name: Group name
attackProtection.description: Create a group and select it in an Attack Protection node in a WAF flow.
attackProtection.loadFailed: Unable to load attack protection groups.
attackProtection.saveFailed: Unable to save the attack protection group.
attackProtection.levelHelp: Essential protection runs rules with specific signatures. Balanced protection adds broader coverage. High protection and observe-only mode run all rules in the category. Individual rule settings take precedence.
attackProtection.legacy: This node uses its existing detection settings. Selecting a group applies its detection levels.
attackProtection.branches: Matches from enabled rules or from Essential, Balanced, or High protection follow the false branch. If only log-only or observe rules match, the request is logged and follows the true branch.

attackProtection.groupNotFound: The attack protection group was not found.

whitelist.title: Global protection allowlist
whitelist.description: When both the domain and path match, the request bypasses global and site-bound WAF flows.
whitelist.deleteDescription: Removing the entry for {domain} and {path} restores WAF checks for matching requests.
whitelist.domainHelp: Exact domains and wildcard domains are supported. *.example.com matches one level of subdomains.

pathHelp.exact: Enter the full path beginning with /. Matching ignores the query string.
pathHelp.prefix: Enter a path prefix beginning with /, such as /api/public/.
pathHelp.suffix: Enter a path suffix, such as .webp.
pathHelp.regex: Enter an RE2 regular expression, such as ^/hooks/[0-9]+$. Matching ignores the query string.
